reviews.title: WORST CARRIER EVER!!! Total SCAM!!!
reviews.text: IDo NOT USE this carrier!! Total SCAM! Save yourself the headaches and aggravation! I pretty much NEVER write bad reviews, but this carrier deserves to be shut down! They make it IMPOSSIBLE to reach customer service! Which doesn’t matter anyway because customer service is completely USELESS! they don’t do anything to help! I had to keep paying for top up data when I just wanted to save money and buy the unlimited plan! But couldn’t reach anybody for 2 weeks and was forced to keep topping up data because I would be out doordashing and run out of data without any warning, no texts to let you know. The app wouldn’t let me change to unlimited plan, it said I needed to contact customer service, which was an impossible JOKE!! Had been on hold multiple times for an hour, just for a recording to come on and say I’d be called back, which they NEVER would! If you’re using them, then you most likely have an unlocked phone, so use pure talk, mint mobile or literally ANY other service but them!! They wouldn’t credit what I had spent on top up data towards the unlimited plan, even though records showed that I’d been trying to reach someone for weeks and had no other choice but to top up data bc there was no way to change my plan. Customer service wouldn’t let me speak to a manager or do anything to help, they need to go out of business because nobody would miss their service. It would save other victims aggravation.
